messages:
Sam (AE): Quick heads-up — ACME wants a POC with dedicated capacity + a 30% commit discount for a 6-month reserved pool. Quote Q-198765. Need clear approval path and exact SF/CPQ fields to set. POC start next week. @Dana can you advise?

Priya (SE): Context: POC requires private deploy (data residency), 4x A100-equivalent capacity. Estimated committed spend pre-discount ~ $50k over 6 months. Also want 5k in POC credits.

Dana (Deal Desk): OK. Treat as "HighTouch - FastTrack". Use CPQ template `POC_DEDICATED_OVERRIDE_v2`. Required fields (set on the Opportunity / Quote):

```
Deal_Type__c = POC_DEDICATED
Commit_Tier__c = 50K_6M
Discount_Type__c = COMMIT_OVERRIDE
Discount_Override__c = 30%
Escalation_Flag__c = TRUE
KMS_Required__c = TRUE  # if private deploy
Billing_Term__c = Prepaid
```

Also attach LOI or signed MSA before final approval.

Liam (RevOps): Routing rule: if Discount_Override__c >= 25% OR Deal_Type__c = POC_DEDICATED => route: DealDesk -> RevOps -> Legal. SLA targets: DealDesk 6h, RevOps 24h, Legal 48h. If customer requests expedite, add tag `EXPEDITE_4H` and @Liam will triage.

LegalBot: Automated check: discount >= 25% + data residency clause triggers mandatory Legal review. Please upload security questionnaire (SIG/ISO) and data handling annex. Tag the opp with `legal-review-required`.

Marisol (CS): We'll own POC ops. Need SOW delta for dedicated infra + success criteria. Sam, can you paste the POC acceptance criteria here? Also confirm SSO/SCIM requirements.

Sam (AE): POC acceptance criteria (short):
- 95th pctile latency < 300ms for target prompts
- sustained throughput 50 rps for 30-minute window
- KV cache persistence across restarts
- data residency in eu-west-1
- success = 3 customer workflows validated
I uploaded a one-pager to the Opportunity attachments (Q-198765).

Priya (SE): Reminder: private deploy requires KMS + HSM integration note in Quote docs. Set `KMS_Required__c = TRUE` and `HSM_Integration__c = PENDING` if not done. Also confirm that POC credits are flagged as non-billable credits (do not count toward commit).

Dana (Deal Desk): I kicked off the Deal Desk ticket. Two manual checks for approval: 1) Finance sign-off on prepaid 6-month commit, 2) confirm POC credits treatment (Marisol please confirm). I'll attach the override amendment template once Legal confirms. If we need to go above 30% discount, escalate to Execs.

Liam (RevOps): I'll prepare the CPQ approval matrix and amendment (amendment template id: AMND-POC-2026-v3). Also setting automation: when `Escalation_Flag__c = TRUE` create task to @Dana with priority = High.

Marisol (CS): Confirmed — POC credits are non-billable and excluded from commit calculation. I'll update the ticket and attach SOW delta.

Sam (AE): Thanks — marking this as high priority. Will post LOI when signed. Please ping me in thread for any missing items. :thumbsup:

Dana (Deal Desk): Received. ETA to initial DealDesk decision 4-6 hours (we're fast-tracking). Will update here with approval id.

LegalBot: Reminder: once files uploaded, run `legal-check --opp Q-198765` (internal bot).
